label: Maxime ens is read as MAXIME_1, MAXIME_2 or MAXIME_3 in both quarta via uses
paraphrase: OPEN frontier premise (coverage, attribution deferred): each of the two uses of the superlative in the quarta via's last step (something is maxime ens; what is maxime in being causes being in all others) is read in one of three senses, merely maximal in being (MAXIME_1, IsMaximalIn at esse), greatest represented degree of being (MAXIME_2, GreatestDegreeBearer at esse) or more a being than every other thing (MAXIME_3, StrictlyGreatestIn at esse), selected by the route's reading, and the use's predicate is exactly that sense's predicate. Anselm's greatest conceivable being is not listed: a rival who reads the quarta via that way denies this premise.
